about: When a routine (a town sweep, a parked-case review) last re-read each hand-checked pin's sources. Kept apart from the pin files so a routine check never changes a fingerprint or needs an owner approval. A routine may change only last_checked_at here; anything else is refused (tools/pin_clocks.py). A pin with no entry has not been re-checked since it was approved. Material updates are not recorded here: they need an owner approval with material set.
